distribution: Huaping Forest Region, Longsheng, Guangxi (altitude about 1300 m).
soldier: Head of the soldier pale yellow, labrum and antennae even paler, mandibles brownish red, thorax and abdomen yellow. Apical setae and lateral apical setae of the labrum distinct, subapical setae short. Setae in the middle region of the pronotum weak and sparse, only about 10. Head oval, narrow anteriorly and broad posteriorly, the transparent area at the labral tip bluntly rounded and projecting. Mandibles rather slender and elongate; left mandible 0.91 times the greatest head width and 0.66 times head capsule length, apex slender and straight. Antennae 15 segments, the third the shortest. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a broad incision, posterior margin more deeply incised in the middle; width about 1.63 times the length, median emargination index 22%.
taxonomy_note: The species was placed in Tsaitermes in the original work; it is here placed in Reticulitermes.
